sources.title: Scene understanding using vision language models
sources.snippet: Using Large Language Models (LLMs) for scene understanding in AV can present challenges. The daily generation of terabytes of data by vehicles makes scalable image analysis difficult from a computational point of view. Small Language Models (SLMs) are more efficient but lack the domain knowledge required for effective scene analysis and need fine-tuning on domain-specific data.
